evals.prompt: I want to compare a second segmentation algorithm that reads the same cleaned page image and still emits page_regions. Add whatever new pipeline component is needed.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the change as a same-socket segment variant rather than a new logical station; preserves grain and artifact socket; declares localized production dependencies; adds focused identity and behavior tests; exposes the registered variant for external research; and leaves the production recipe unchanged.

evals.prompt: My new layout analyzer needs an additional page-level artifact and changes the required fields in page_regions. Can I just add optional reads to segment?
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as an artifact contract and station graph change, rejects undeclared or compatibility-shim reads, identifies the single contract and workspace path updates, requires registry/conductor/failure tests, regenerates CONTRACTS.md from live registries, and leaves comparative evaluation to the external research repository.
